summary: Frontend-only QA of SEDUC/CEV rebrand across all public pages on desktop (1920x800), Android Pixel 7 (412x915) and iPhone 13 (390x844). Full registration flow (inicio -> termos -> inscricao -> dados-inscricao -> confirmacao -> inscricao-realizada -> pagamento-pix) completed end-to-end on desktop with no errors. All layout/branding checks pass on all 3 device profiles.
critical_code_review_comments: inicio.html and termos.html include the CEV footer inline but DO NOT expose data-testid="site-footer" on the footer node (the testid only appears on pages that get the SEDUC header injected via /seduc/seduc-theme.js). Footer text ('Universidade Estadual do Ceará - UECE') is present and renders correctly, so this is cosmetic/testing-hook only. If the testid is required by spec, add it to the footer wrapper in inicio.html / termos.html.

Several legacy container IDs from the old AOCP/FGV theme still exist in the DOM of flow pages (e.g. #__fgv_topbar, #__fgv_footer, #__fgv_layout, #__cebraspe_footer_root, #TopMenu, #Topo, #Rodape). They are correctly hidden/overridden by CSS and do NOT leak any visible text (verified: no visible 'Instituto AOCP', 'SESA/AP', 'Cebraspe', 'SAEB' or 'FGV' strings on any tested page). Consider cleaning these up in seduc_rebrand.py for maintainability.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Public URL: https://concurso-seduc-ce.preview.emergentagent.com . Use wait_until='domcontentloaded' (not networkidle - site has long-polling scripts that never idle). Mobile viewports 412x915 (Android) and 390x844 (iOS) show zero horizontal overflow on all 8 public pages. SEDUC header is injected via Shadow DOM host #seduc-header-host on inner flow pages (inscricao, dados-inscricao, confirmacao, inscricao-realizada, pagamento-pix, minhas-inscricoes); inicio.html and termos.html use their own inline CEV header (host is null on those two). Form IDs on inscricao.html: #CEP, input[name=NOME], #CPF, #DATA_NASCIMENTO, select[name=SEXO], #NUMERO, #CELULAR (not #CEL), #EMAIL, #DOC_TIPO (not #TP_DOCUMENTO), #DOC_FRENTE, #DOC_VERSO, #declaracao_veracidade, #btn-salvar. On dados-inscricao: #VAGA (87 options), #MUNICIPIO_PROVA (3 options), input[name=termo]. Pagamento-pix correctly shows 'Chave PIX não configurada' (admin not configured - expected per spec).
